info.name: Cloud Application Security Account Management DDoS for Networks Test Alerts API

params.name: ip_prefix
params.description: The IP prefix to send a notification for. For example, 10.10.10.10

items.docs:
Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that an Infrastructure Protection DDoS attack has started.
You can optionally provide additional parameters to determine the magnitude of the attack.

params.name: ip_prefix
params.description: The IP prefix to send a notification for. For example, 10.10.10.10

items.docs:
Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that an Infrastructure Protection DDoS attack has ended.
You can optionally provide additional parameters to determine the magnitude of the attack.

params.name: connection_name
params.description:
The connection to send a notification for.
Enter the connection name as it appears in the Cloud Security Console’s Protection Settings page. For example, Test_GRE_Tunnel.

items.docs:
Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that the Infrastructure Protection connection is down.
You can optionally provide the name of the connection as it appears in the Management Console’s Protection Settings page.

params.name: connection_name

The connection to send a notification for.

items.docs:
Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that the Infrastructure Protection connection is up.
You can optionally provide the name of the connection as it appears in the Management Console’s Protection Settings page.

params.name: ip_protection
params.description: The IP to send a notification for. For example, 10.10.10.10

items.docs: Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that the IP Protection status is up.

items.docs: Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that the IP Protection status is down.

params.name: exporter_ip
params.description:
The exporter IP to send a notification for. For example, 10.10.10.10.
The exporter IP can be found in the Cloud Security Console’s Monitoring Settings page.

items.docs:
Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that flow monitoring has started.
You can optionally provide the exporter IP found in the Management Console’s Monitoring Settings page.

params.name: exporter_ip

The exporter IP can be found in the Cloud Security Console’s Monitoring Settings page.

Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that the monitoring service is receiving messages that do not conform to the accepted format.
You can optionally provide the exporter IP found in the Management Console’s Monitoring Settings page.

params.name: ip_prefix
params.description: The IP range to send a notification for. For example, 1.1.1.0/24

params.name: packet_type
params.description: Packet type. (UDP, TCP, DNS, DNS_RESPONSE, ICMP, SYN, FRAG, LARGE_SYN, NTP, NETFLOW, SSDP, GENERAL)

items.docs:
Use this operation to send a test notification informing you that the monitoring service has detected a DDoS attack.
You can optionally provide additional parameters to determine the magnitude of the attack.
